title: Bard Math Circle Creative and Analytical Math Program (CAMP)
text:
The Creative and Analytical Math Program (CAMP) is a non-residential academic math program for students moving up into grades 6–9 in the fall. CAMP happens for one week during the summer on the beautiful and secluded Bard College campus in Annandale-on-Hudson, NY.

CAMP is a mathematical enrichment opportunity for students who want to explore challenging math in a relaxed setting. Engaging classes and activities are led by experienced educators and undergraduate math majors. We emphasize hands-on math, teamwork, outside-the-box thinking and creative problem-solving.

CAMP launched in 2014 and gratefully acknowledges the support of the Dolciani Math Enrichment Grant Program in its formative years, as well as the AMS Epsilon Award in 2020.

For more information, please visit https://bardmathcircle.org/camp/
